scenes.say: The road to Formula One is expensive: Russell's father spent about one and a half million pounds, and George paid it back.
On the twelfth of November Russell launched the G R sixty-three academy with Silverstone and the BRDC.
Russell himself got in a kart at seven. Now he's looking for kids whose families can't fund a start.
Boys and girls aged eight and nine can take part, if their family may lack the budget for karting.
Qualifiers at Silverstone run from the sixth to the thirty-first of December, twenty-five pounds a session.
The best eighty from the qualifiers go to a shoot-out at the end of January.
Twenty-five get places in the twenty twenty-seven championship. Everything is paid for, even the overalls and helmet.
And the winner gets a fully funded karting season in twenty twenty-eight.
Race news and the live map: LapRadar.

title: Russell launches the GR63 Academy: funded karting for kids whose families may lack the budget
